name: xt50_brainstorm_to_draft
scenario: A marketer wants help thinking through and then drafting a LinkedIn post for the Fujifilm X-T50.
expected_outcome: Signal offers a few distinct angles, then on request drafts a LinkedIn post using only the supplied X-T50 facts, without inventing specs or claims.
user_turns: Help me brainstorm a LinkedIn post about the Fujifilm X-T50. Facts I can use: 40.2 MP APS-C X-Trans CMOS 5 HR sensor, 7-stop in-body image stabilization, 6.2K/30p video, 20 Film Simulation modes.
Go with the film-simulation-for-video angle and draft it. Professional tone, under 180 words.

name: sandisk_blog_post_supported
scenario: A marketer asks for a blog post (not a LinkedIn post) about the SanDisk Extreme SD card.
expected_outcome: Signal helps with the blog post rather than refusing or redirecting to LinkedIn, and uses only the supplied facts.
user_turns: I need a blog post about the SanDisk Extreme SD UHS-I 128GB Card. Facts: 128 GB capacity, up to 180 MB/s read, up to 90 MB/s write, UHS-I U3 and V30, good for 4K UHD video.
Lead with the 'ran out of card space mid-shoot' problem, then bring in the product.

name: marshall_revise_keeps_facts
scenario: A marketer drafts a Marshall Willen II post, then asks for a tightening pass.
expected_outcome: The revised post still contains the originally supplied Marshall facts and adds no new specifications.
user_turns: Draft a professional LinkedIn post for the Marshall Willen II under 90 words. Facts: 17+ hours playtime, IP67 dust and waterproof, built-in mic for calls, Bluetooth LE Audio, rubber fastening strap.
Tighten it and add a single CTA line to visit the product page.

name: sandisk_grounding_flags
scenario: A marketer asks for a post but has only vague benefits, no numbers.
expected_outcome: Signal drafts from what it was told and flags any specific speed or capacity claim it was not given as an open question, instead of inventing one.
user_turns: Write a LinkedIn post: the SanDisk Extreme card is fast and reliable for creators. Product name is SanDisk Extreme SD Card.
That's all I have, draft it.

name: xt50_exploratory_positioning
scenario: A marketer is still deciding how to position a camera and wants an upbeat, confident LinkedIn post once an angle is chosen.
expected_outcome: Signal proposes positioning angles, marks anything not in the supplied facts as an assumption, and when asked writes a confident, upbeat post.
user_turns: I'm not sure how to pitch the Fujifilm X-T50 yet - help me find an angle. Confirmed facts: 40.2 MP sensor, 7-stop IBIS, tilting LCD.
Take the 'travel camera that keeps up' angle and write a confident, upbeat post.
